system.description:
This smart plastic loop restricts around a prisoner’s limbs when activated. If the prisoner struggles, it will tighten more. Cuffbands will inform the user if they are cut or loosened and are electronically-controlled, so the user can release the prisoner remotely. Some cuffband variants including a shock system (treat as a shock baton, p. 334) to zap and restrain unruly prisoners.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 316.
